Billy needs to peel and cut 60 potatoes. Peeling one potato takes 1 minute and 30 seconds, which is 90 seconds. Cutting one potato takes 5 seconds. So the total time per potato is 90 + 5 = 95 seconds.

For 60 potatoes, the total time is 60 × 95 = 5700 seconds. To convert to minutes, divide by 60: 5700 ÷ 60 = 95 minutes. That is 1 hour and 35 minutes.

Answer: 95 minutes (or 1 hour 35 minutes)
